Execution class): "Each other creature that player controls gets -2/-0
until end of turn," where "that player" is the controller of the
permanent a PRIOR atom in this same spell sequence acted on
(gs.seqSlotsStr["referent"], the same cross-atom referent slot
grant_keywords_referent_eot/gain_control_referent_eot consume) — not a

of its own: the mass recipient is derived entirely from the referent's
controller, read while the referent is still on the battlefield (a
preceding "destroy target creature" atom marks it for a state-based
removal that hasn't pulled it off the battlefield yet when this atom
runs later in the same resolution).

resolution.excerpt:
14783 	case "untap_referent":
14784 		// auto_untap_referent_target_b538048b69 primitive (Bloody Betrayal
14785 		// class: "Gain control of target creature until end of turn. Untap
14786 		// that creature. ..."). The untap is a STANDALONE untargeted
14787 		// sequence atom whose subject "that creature" refers to whatever
14788 		// card a PRECEDING atom in this same sequence most recently acted
14789 		// on (gs.seqSlotsStr["referent"], armed by executeEffectSequenceEv's
14790 		// per-atom bookkeeping in effect_sequence.go's noteSeqReferent).
14791 		// Deliberately left untargeted so it can sit between the
14792 		// referent-establishing atom (gain_control, etc.) and a later
14793 		// referent-consuming atom (grant_keywords_referent_eot) without
14794 		// breaking either. Mirrors gain_control_referent_eot's referent
14795 		// read above; the untap itself mirrors executeUntapEffect's
14796 		// Card.Untap + EventUntapped pair. No-op if no referent is armed
14797 		// or the referent can no longer be found on the battlefield.
14798 		if gs.seqSlotsStr == nil {
14799 			return nil
14800 		}
14801 		refID := gs.seqSlotsStr["referent"]
14802 		if refID == "" {
14803 			return nil
14804 		}
14805 		card, err := gs.Battlefield.GetCard(refID)
14806 		if err != nil || card == nil {
14807 			return nil
14808 		}
14809 		card.Untap()
14810 		if gs.EventBus != nil {
14811 			gs.ProcessTriggeredAbilities(NewEvent(EventUntapped).WithSource(card).WithPlayer(card.Controller))
14812 		}
14813 		return nil

1360 type Player struct {

 1364 	ManaPool    ManaPool `json:"mana_pool"`
 1365 	HasPriority bool     `json:"has_priority"` // Rule 117 - Timing and Priority
 1366 
 1367 	// StartingLife records the life total this player began the game with
 1368 	// (Rule 119.1) — fixed at NewPlayer and never touched again, so "as long
 1369 	// as your life total is [more/less] than [half/N more than] your
 1370 	// starting life total" conditions (Anya Merciless Angel, Elenda Saint of
 1371 	// Dusk, Myrkul Lord of Bones, Righteous Valkyrie kin) can compare Life
 1372 	// against a stable baseline instead of the game's default StartingLife
 1373 	// (wrong for Commander's 40 vs Constructed's 20).
 1374 	StartingLife int `json:"starting_life"`

 1378 	Hand      *Zone `json:"hand"`
 1379 	Graveyard *Zone `json:"graveyard"`
 1380 	Exile     *Zone `json:"exile"`
 1381 	Command   *Zone `json:"command"` // Rule 408 - command zone (Commander)
 1382 	// CommanderDamage tracks combat damage taken from each commander (by card
 1383 	// ID) this game; 21 from one commander loses (Rule 704.5v).
 1384 	CommanderDamage map[string]int `json:"commander_damage,omitempty"`
 1385

 1389 	HasDrawnThisTurn    bool            `json:"has_drawn_this_turn"` // For miracle tracking
 1390 	DeckID              string          `json:"deck_id"`             // Reference to deck used
 1391 	AutoPassUntil       AutoPassSetting `json:"auto_pass_until"`     // Auto-pass until specified phase
 1392 
 1393 	// Rule 106.11 — Energy is a player-scoped non-mana resource. Unlike
 1394 	// mana it persists across phases/turns and is only ever spent by an
 1395 	// effect that explicitly pays "{E}".
 1396 	EnergyCounters int `json:"energy"`
 1397 
 1398 	// Experience counters (Rule 122.1a) — player-scoped, only ever
 1399 	// accumulate ("you get an experience counter"); commander-2015-style
 1400 	// effects scale off the total.
 1401 	ExperienceCounters int `json:"experience,omitempty"`
 1402

 1404 	// Frodo, Sauron's Bane class: "if the Ring has tempted you four or more
 1405 	// times this game..."). Game-lifetime persistent, mirrors
 1406 	// ExperienceCounters immediately above (only ever accumulates, never
 1407 	// reset by NextTurn — the condition explicitly reads "this game", not
 1408 	// "this turn"). Incremented by GameState.RingTemptsPlayer, which also
 1409 	// publishes EventRingTempts for "whenever the Ring tempts you" triggers
 1410 	// (Gandalf, Friend of the Shire and others currently document this as a
 1411 	// MISSING_PRIMITIVE gap).
 1412 	RingTemptedCount int `json:"ring_tempted_count,omitempty"`
 1413

resolution.doc:
regEffect registers a primitive from a per-round file. NEW ROUNDS MUST use
a dedicated backend/cards/registry_<topic>.go with

	func init() { regEffect("verb", Primitive{...}) }

instead of appending to the V2EffectRegistry literal above — tail-appends to
the literal are a recurring merge-conflict class (5 conflicts in one night,
2026-08-02, incl. brace-truncations and duplicated fields from marker-union
resolution). The literal is FROZEN; init() files never conflict.
Panics on duplicate so a bad merge fails the build instead of silently
shadowing an entry. (Package-level var init runs before any init(), so the
literal is always populated first.)
resolution.name: regEffect

resolution.doc: Event represents a game event that can trigger abilities
resolution.excerpt:
438 type Event struct {
  439 	Type     EventType              `json:"type"`
  440 	Source   *Card                  `json:"source,omitempty"`    // Card that caused the event
  441 	Target   *Card                  `json:"target,omitempty"`    // Card affected (if any)
  442 	Player   int                    `json:"player"`              // Player index involved
  443 	Opponent int                    `json:"opponent,omitempty"`  // Opponent index (if relevant)
  444 	Amount   int                    `json:"amount,omitempty"`    // For damage/life events
  445 	Zone     ZoneType               `json:"zone,omitempty"`      // Zone involved
  446 	FromZone ZoneType               `json:"from_zone,omitempty"` // For zone change events
  447 	ToZone   ZoneType               `json:"to_zone,omitempty"`   // For zone change events
  448 	Data     map[string]interface{} `json:"data,omitempty"`      // Additional event-specific data
  449 	// SpellsThisTurn snapshots the caster's per-turn spell count at the
  450 	// time of a spell-cast event so triggers like "your second spell each
  451 	// turn" can match without separately consulting the GameState.
  452 	SpellsThisTurn int `json:"spells_this_turn,omitempty"`
  453 	// ManaSpent snapshots the total mana actually paid for a spell-cast
  454 	// event (post cost-reduction), so triggers like "if less mana was spent
  455 	// to cast it than its mana value" can compare against the card's CMC.
  456 	ManaSpent int `json:"mana_spent,omitempty"`
  457 	// CounterKind is the counter type for an EventCounterAdded event (e.g.
  458 	// CounterPlusOnePlusOne).
  459 	CounterKind CounterType `json:"counter_kind,omitempty"`
  460 	// DieSides and DieResult carry an EventDieRoll's die-roll payload
  461 	// ([VOCAB] #1186): the face count rolled and the FINAL result (after any
  462 	// Player.DieRollModifier ran). Set once by cardfns.RollDieForPlayer
  463 	// before Publish; observers (cardfns.OnDieRoll) only ever read these —
  464 	// unlike a mutate-during-Publish scheme, the modifier phase is already
  465 	// finished by the time this event is built, so subscriber ordering
  466 	// cannot race the result.
  467 	DieSides  int `json:"die_sides,omitempty"`
  468 	DieResult int `json:"die_result,omitempty"`
  469 }

 1163 	subscribers map[EventType][]EventHandler
 1164 	owned       map[EventType][]ownedSub
 1165 	abilities   []*TriggeredAbility
 1166 	queue       []*Event // Event queue for processing
 1167 
 1168 	// TriggerSuppressionQuery, if set, is consulted by Publish before
 1169 	// matching TriggeredAbility instances against an event — the negative
 1170 	// mirror of Card.TriggerDoubler ([VOCAB] #9: "suppress triggers by event
 1171 	// type"). Returning true for the event's EventType means NO triggered
 1172 	// ability matches this Publish call, for any player, e.g. a static
 1173 	// ability like "Creatures dying don't cause abilities to trigger."
 1174 	// Wired by GameState.SetupGlobalSubscribers (gs.isTriggerEventSuppressed)
 1175 	// so EventBus itself stays free of any GameState/Battlefield dependency;
 1176 	// nil (the default, e.g. a bare NewEventBus() in a test) means no
 1177 	// suppression — unchanged behavior. Only gates the TriggeredAbility
 1178 	// match list, not the Subscribe/SubscribeAll handler loop above — see
 1179 	// the SCOPE GAP note on Publish for why.
 1180 	TriggerSuppressionQuery func(EventType) bool
 1181 }
